electrical_architecture.expected_real_output_under_load: about 1.87-1.95 V in existing steady-state simulations at 48V 100-120A; not a regulated 2.000V rail

must_not_relax: real primary and all eight SR gate shutdown
power on reset and stuck ACK prevention
magnetic L(I) at 100 C and real physical terminal/DOT
MOSFET pulsed forward and third-quadrant SOA
netted PCB, GUI ERC/DRC, thermal and electrical isolation
manufacturer-confirmed BOM and no unsafe placeholder

stages.purpose: separate low-energy protection and SR-controller bench with emulated MOS gate loads
required_real_evidence: 8 SR disables + 2 primary gate disables demonstrated with separate bias fails
cold-start short, stuck-reset and lost-rail fault injection

stages.purpose: first functional high-current 24:1 LLC-DCX hardware demonstrator; make mechanical clearance feasible
required_real_evidence: D0 ten-gate protect implemented and characterized
T1-T4/CT 24 physical pins and DOT; Lr 100C L(I) qualified
actual height with PCB/clamp/adhesive/cold plate interfaces <=16mm
native schematic and routed copper, ERC/DRC and thermal proof
25,50,75,100A staged tests at 46/48/50V with measured Vin/Iout/Vout and loss

stages.purpose: power expansion only after D1 credible fault, SOA and temperature proof
required_real_evidence: D1 operating, protection and temperature evidence
50V fault and cold-start transients with validated 100C magnetics and eight-SR SOA
Cout 100kHz ESR, 200kHz/temperature ripple and shared copper measured

stages.purpose: optional 10mm low-profile optimization once D1/D2 behavior and cold plate are stable
required_real_evidence: custom magnetic full Z and L(I), flux/loss verified
repeat D1/D2 thermal and electrical/protection comparison after topology changes

staged_go_no_go.gate_for_D1: 10 gate safe hardware + real magnetics/CT pins DOT and L(I) + native board ERC/DRC and SOA/thermal; size is 16mm target, not 10mm
staged_go_no_go.gate_for_D2: D1 approved plus 120A independent full-load and worst-case fault evidence
staged_go_no_go.gate_for_D3: D1 or D2 approved plus <=10mm reengineered magnetics and new assembly/thermal signoff

stop_loss_rules.trigger: both v3_4 2fF B runs complete 320us and matched
stop_loss_rules.action: no more 1/2/5/10 fF repeats without a new physical-model defect; shift to actual hardware EN/TRIG and MOS stress

stop_loss_rules.trigger: two independent 10mm geometry trials have no validated full-stack+L(I) solution
stop_loss_rules.action: use 16mm D1/D2 route and an ELP38/ELP43 manufacturer quotation, leave 10mm in D3

stop_loss_rules.trigger: 100A hardware fails derated steady-state thermal or fault SOA after one root-cause revision
stop_loss_rules.action: commission protected 75A or 50A characterization demonstrator, not an unsafe 100A release; preserve 100A as next validation target

stop_loss_rules.trigger: automatic reconstruction cannot reliably resolve vendor physical DOT/pads and netted PCB
stop_loss_rules.action: stop guessing pinouts; send 24 physical-pad map + ECO table to EDA engineer and supplier; hardware release still blocked

preferred_parallel_workstreams: D0 low-energy control bench schematic & bill of materials
D1 native schematic real MPN/R3 footprint/pad ERC & netted PCB
D1 output bank higher voltage and path impedance extraction
D2 120A stress only after D1 qualified

mechanical_planning.provenance: Provisional early-stage engineering allowance, NOT an OEM minimum; total actual stack must be measured
mechanical_planning.includes: PCB pad/solder/insert/clamp/TIM/coldplate interface; actual allocation remains open
